sessions.intent: Stage 1: a value is born whole — the base item holds its registered type, set at construction, forwarded by every subtype; the INTO-plang implicit operators go; Create(raw) takes the type; the re-resolves, text floor, :754, source.cs:240, action-slot checks, list doors, bare-type makers, image _mime and name-sniffing all collapse.

before.assumptions: Ingi approved fork (a): every value is born with its type from the app's list (the app always exists). The 28 subtype Type overrides rebuild the type per read; source.cs:115 floors text's IsText by Name; three re-resolves (type.Get:886, Out:63, Setting:900) patch the bare type at navigation.
before.risk: Big-bang: base item ctor becomes required (type.@this), so every subtype ctor and every construction site must supply the type at birth. Removing ~28 INTO-plang implicit operators surfaces a large caller wall (number especially). Must land as one coherent change with the 6 reds green, guards green, no new reds vs runtime2.

actions.context: Wrote stage-1 plan and captured baseline (3 stage-1 reds: ImageFromBytes_Kind_CarriesItsRegisteredMime, PlainText_Kind_IsText_WithoutNameFloor, AFreshTypeByNameCarriesNoFacts; 6 Wire + TheActorNamed pre-existing). Mapped all 28 subtypes (ctors/Type overrides/kind sources/self-construction) and the scattered sites (3 re-resolves, floor, :754, :240, image _mime, name-sniffs, 4 action-slot checks, bare-type makers, list doors) via two Explore agents.

Surfaced the hinge to the architect: context-free births (bool.True singleton, sniffed image FromBytes, text.ToUpper, number arithmetic) have no app, yet the 3 reds demand whole kind facts + by-name ClrType. Proposed a static assembly-scan facts cache ([Format]/[PlangType] metadata) backing the kind/by-name ctor — matches Ingi's 'facts from class declarations' and 876 'by-name ctor becomes the list's own'. Flagged as a new static (no-static-without-consent) + locked-core (type system). Holding the 28-file big-bang on the answer.

Architect ruled (decision 880): NO static — every birth reaches the app's type via its maker (type.Make hands the registered type), from the value it came from (this.Type), or a passed context; the by-name test is the test-designer's to reroute. Enumerated the four static value singletons that can't hold an app's type and delivered the list with uses to the architect (REPLY asked for the singletons list first): bool.True/False (7 uses, mostly [Out,Store] setting field-defaults), null.Instance (the typeless-null citizen, ~18 uses — proposed exempt), given.Instance (1 use), culture.Machine (1 use). Holding the base-ctor big-bang until the architect rules how these four get their type.

Phase 1 (facts fix, static-free): the type entity, when built from a CLR class, reads its class's [Format] into its kind (KindOfClass via reflection — the empty kind now carries its _format, a named kind is a kind.format<T>). empty kind ctor takes an optional format. image's Type override passes the kind NAME so the type builds it from [Format]. Both Types reds green (PlainText_Kind_IsText_WithoutNameFloor, ImageFromBytes_Kind_CarriesItsRegisteredMime); Types suite 32/0, no regressions. This is the foundation born-whole builds each value's _type on.

Wrote the born-whole execution map (per-subtype forwarding type, operator-removal list, singleton handling, collapses). Surfaced two locked-core forks the briefing didn't cover and the architect ruled both: (1) meta-type recursion — Ingi: one self-typed root in the app's list (ctor sets _type=this), type+kind forward it via : base(root), no Type override. (2) the scope hinge now open — a value's type entity holds the per-app root (needs context), but the two green Types reds + internal helpers construct values context-free; asked whether origin-births route through context (option a, values always from the list/Make/context, the 2 Types tests reroute like the by-name one) vs keep context-free value ctors (option b). Holding the base-ctor big-bang on that answer.

Integrated architect/test-designer commits (decision 886; 2 Types tests + ActionSlot rerouted through app.type.list). Verified: reds 1&2 GREEN via the facts fix through the app's Create door (thread-safe). Red 3 (AKindedSlot) needs a targeted element-kind ClrType fix. Found and surfaced a hard COLLISION with concrete evidence: the required base ctor + per-app root (884) + no-static (882) collides with the type system's ~15 STATIC kind singletons — number's precision kinds (number/this.cs:57-71, `static readonly kind.@this @int = new kind.@int.@this()`) and other static kinds across ~50 kind classes. kind.@this : type.@this : item.@this, so every kind would have to hold the per-app root, but a static can't. Full swing = ~100+ files atomic + ~15 static-kind rulings (every number op would need the app for its precision kind). Offered 3 paths to the architect: (A) full per-app-kinds swing, (B) ship observable reds-green (facts fix + element fix + no-base-ctor collapses), (C) lighter born-whole (only value types born-whole; type/kind keep static bootstrap). Reverted the base-ctor change to keep the tree green (facts-fix-only). Holding for the ruling.

Ingi ruled (A) in 3 green steps (887/888): number ops are derived births (kind from the operand's own type, app-owned) so only origin births need the app. STEP 1 groundwork pushed: (1) base item got the born-whole foundation — a `_type` field, `@this(type.@this type)` ctor, a temporary parameterless stand-in, and `Type => _type ?? rebuild` (non-breaking: a value not yet moved falls back to the old rebuild). (2) image fix as briefed: Sniff returns only the kind name; the image's Mime is asked of its type's kind; `_mime` and the hard-coded mime pairs removed; serializers pass only the kind. (3) red 3: `ClrType` made virtual, `list<action>`'s element kind overrides it to carry the registered action's ClrType. All three C# reds green (reds 1&2 via the pushed facts fix; red 3 via the element fix). Surface re-pinned under 887/888 (image ctor + item's new ctor). Test fixes: ImageFormatTests, ImageValueTests to the new 2-arg image ctor. NOT yet done: the per-ctor `: base(type)` moves for the value types (the 'values hold the type' headline) — asked the architect whether to do them in step 1 or at step 3's required-ctor move. Flake flagged to architect/tester: ImageFromBytes + the text/image tests share `new app.@this("/app")` and race under TUnit parallelism (pass in isolation).

Step 1 value-type moves (Ingi's go: move every value type to : base(type), delete each Type override). Pattern: a ctor forwards the type to base; Make hands the registered type, a legacy/operator build self-builds the same type. Learnings: (a) Activator matches ctors by exact arg count — no optional param for Activator-constructed types (choice); (b) born-whole makes Type/kind EAGER, which can trigger a static init or throw the old lazy Type avoided (choice<nameless-enum> — fixed by reading the set name from T's [PlangType] directly, not the throwing _set). PUSHED + GREEN, 22 value types born-whole (commits 8da3f0faf, fb0c7f778, 738a1c913, 026f9945e): guid, date, time, datetime, tag, bool, culture, note, note.line, number, duration, choice, source, prose, computed, base64, binary, image, path, file, url, null. path takes its scheme as a ctor arg; null holds its declared type or the null type. Surface re-pinned each push.

Settings born-whole, no exception (891, Ingi): every settings class (~23) gets `public X(type.@this type) : base(type) {}`; the base setting ctors carry the type; the reflection sites (actor/setting, item/setting, Executor.Flag) pass it from the app's list (Activator.CreateInstance(clr, app.type.list[clr])); the discovery gate checks for the (type) ctor; ISetting/IConcept/Of<T>/Listed<T> drop their new() constraint; owned-setting field-defaults and `new X()` callers/tests pass the type. Pushed b5b03185e, 43 files, all green (Modules/Data/Generator/Runtime 0; Types 1 = ImageFromBytes parallel flake; Wire 6 baseline). OPEN QUESTION to architect: text/dict/list/separator flag template only when a container inner slot's content holds a variable (literal slots stay plain so signing/canonicalization don't change) — a content-decided, post-construction fact the born-at-ctor type can't capture. Proposed: the reader decides template-ness from content and hands the value a type carrying the template only when a var is held. Holding on that before reshaping text/dict/list (touches signing). Remaining: text, dict, list, separator, list<T> (element kind), content (file/url lazy base, GetType-like).

item-doors 41: modifier class + modifier.list replace the enum; mouse/key hold Modifier from birth; Bits renamed Code (Ingi); key's VK naming stays on the key (43); dict.key, modifier, modifier.list internal so the decider pin is back. Pushed 4c6b7cde8.

item-doors 33 step 4: required ctor per type; makers hand the app's type; readers ask the context's list; the Windows window gets the type list at birth. Interims flagged: culture.Machine, call frame StartedAt/CompletedAt, input numbers via number.Create(x)!. Pushed 1c1833878, e5c21d879, 71ed14eac, 89e76eb90, 48712efa2.
item-doors 42/47: parts and units are one-context [LlmBuilder] members answering data<T>.From(context.Ok(raw)) — the existing typed door; no helper, no cast; %now.year% unchanged.

Measured 42's scope by marking the 22 into-plang operators [Obsolete(error)] (reverted): 1,726 production lines, 1,330 error status codes (906 generator-emitted). Blocked list sent to the architect: kinded types, status, bool, typeless null (Ingi).

item-doors 49: Kinded removed; a kindless leaf declared a kind is made through the type's Make (its courier re-births a value of its class holding the declared type); base64 and binary born with the app's type.

item-doors 52: every Data born with its context (a birth guard found the sites); Instance/Absent gone; FromError/NotFound/Uninitialized/Null take the context; the emitter hands __ctx/context/Context; the C# Get doors take the asker's context; the app's null is one value per type (an empty value whose Copy is itself is kept). ~110 test files moved by two Haiku passes, checked per class.

item-doors 51/56/57: the call stack is handed the app's datetime and {duration, short}; duration born (TimeSpan, type) and written by its type's kind (kind.Write, Ingi's locked addition); duration.Text and its ToString go — a duration shown as text is its Output (Fluid's span converter writes it through a text writer).
item-doors 60/61: one Fluid value over any plang item (Output, IsTruthy, Compare; ordering operators registered); the span-only converter goes. A type written alone in the Out view is its face.

item-doors 62-64 (group 8): the app's nodes move to app/type/node as items of the internal type node; Replace goes; events through the plain type; the goal offer goes (64); the type `type` is made by its list holding it. Trace sent first; the Offers gap (no app reachable) went to the architect, answered by 64. error.Exception made internal, plang reads %!error.trace% (Show_A500, 60's red).
